title: Kitty Block Jam
description: Slide plump cat-shaped polyomino blocks across cozy puzzle boards to clear pathways and match every kitty with its exit.
controls: Drag cat blocks horizontally or vertically to untangle the grid and guide each kitty to its matching color gate.

zh-CN.title: 猫咪玩方块
zh-CN.description: 软萌猫咪主题滑块拼图：挪动圆滚滚的猫咪积木块腾出通路，把每只小猫顺利送进对应的彩色出口。
zh-CN.controls: 按住拖动猫咪方块在棋盘内滑动，规划挪动顺序消除全部猫咪方块即可通关。
